content.comment_body: Good morning, I have an "unknown" [article_no]. If the IP address isn't set to 192.168.0.3, what steps can I take to determine its correct IP address? Is there a possibility to reset the unit? Thank you for your response.
To provide accurate assistance, we'll need more details. Which [product_name] do you have exactly? Please specify the complete order number of the [product_name].
The order number is: [article_no] MAC: BC-F3-19-03-8D-30
You have a [product_name] without display. In this case, you can only view the IP address by using the [product_name] software tool.

You can perform a factory reset by using the [product_name] software or the Reset Tool. For the Reset Tool, you'll need a FAT32 formatted SD card with up to 32 GB capacity. The Reset Tool can be downloaded here: [url]
Thank you for your prompt reply.

When the software tool detects an "Unknown" [product_name], it is still able to communicate with the device. In the "Unknown" device, you'll find a gear icon; clicking it will open the properties window where the IP address is displayed. The software designates it as "Unknown" if you haven't yet downloaded the program into the tool.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience challenges locating the IP address for a [product_name] (without display) when it's listed as 'unknown' in the software interface. The procedure can be confusing for those unfamiliar with software-only interaction and might lack clear instructions within the application, especially regarding device status and possible actions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to obtain or reset the IP address on a [product_name] without display—even when it's marked as 'unknown'—and desire clear guidance on the abilities of the software tool and any hardware limitations.
